name: research_agent
description: Searches the web via Tavily, has an LLM supervisor judge whether the results are sufficient (re-searching up to the iteration cap if not), then synthesizes a final answer. Requires TAVILY_API_KEY and GROQ_API_KEY to be set on the worker. Built for #39: exercises supervisor against real, unpredictable LLM output rather than simulated test payloads.

steps.prompt_template:
You are deciding whether web search results are sufficient to answer a question. You will be asked this repeatedly as new searches run.

Question: {{user_input}}

Most recent search results:
{{search.output}}

Rules:
- The very first time you are asked this (before any additional search has run beyond the original one), always respond with exactly: search
- On every later time you are asked, if the results so far are sufficient to answer the question, respond with exactly: done
- Otherwise, respond with exactly: search

Respond with only one of those two words, nothing else.
